responsibility: Defines the built-in target specification for the 64-bit x86 `x86_64h` macOS variant, combining Apple macOS defaults with deployment-target-sensitive LLVM triple selection, always-on frame pointers, x86 stack-probe behavior, 128-bit atomic support, Darwin mcount naming, supported sanitizers, and a reduced feature set derived from the `core-avx2` CPU baseline to match `x86_64h` semantics.
